blocking_reasons.message: Five project-original procedural assets exist and pass technical decode QA, but none has been auditioned in context yet.
The project rights holder has not yet confirmed synchronization, modification, rendering, and Git distribution of the generated assets.

required_before_ready: audio file exists inside project/assets/music and matches its recorded SHA-256
track is auditioned against dialogue and production sound
fade and ducking render passes music-mix QA
forbidden: a track marked ready without an existing local asset
